newsitem.title: USA: TVA 1,148 MW Sequoyah nuke boosting power.
newsitem.headline: TVA 1,148 MW Sequoyah nuke boosting power.

text.p: Tennessee Valley Authority's 1,148 megawatt (MW) Sequoyah nuclear power unit 2 was boosting power toward 100 percent Monday after an outage due to an electrical problem, Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said.
The Soddy-Daisy, Tenn., unit was operating at 50 percent of capacity and was increasing power to full as of early Monday, the NRC said in its daily plant status report.
Sequoyah 2 was shut Friday due to an electrical problem that resulted in the loss of two reactor coolant pumps.
The 1,148 MW Sequoyah unit 1 continued to operate normally, the NRC said in the status report.
